svg.title: Opening the panel from a link: loading, a failed load, no such team, a team changed elsewhere, and browser Back
svg.desc: A: Edit team on Docs opened from a link while it loads: the title shows, the body says Loading the Docs team…, Save changes is off with Loading… beside it. B: New team while it loads: Team name and Start from work, the template select says Loading templates…, the agents list waits for engines and profiles. C: the load failed, with the server's words and Try again. D: no team by that name, with Back to the Agents page. E: the save refused because the team changed somewhere else, with Reload the team and Keep my changes here, and the in-place question Reload asks. F: browser Back with unsaved changes asks the discard question in place, focus on Keep editing. Light theme, existing tokens.
svg.text: Opening the panel from a link
The panel lives at /agents?team=new or ?team={team}, so a reload, a link or Back can open it before anything has loaded. Words from copy.md.
A · EDIT TEAM, LOADING (?team=Docs)
Edit the Docs team
Loading the Docs team…
Loading…
Cancel
Save changes
1 · Edit loads with nothing to lose
The title comes from the link, so it shows at once. The body says "Loading the Docs team…" (a polite live
region) until the agents, engines, profiles and templates are in; no fields show, so nothing can be typed and lost.
Save changes is off with "Loading…" beside it (aria-describedby). Cancel, Close and Esc close at once.
B · NEW TEAM, LOADING (?team=new)
New team
Team name
Release
Start from
Blank
Copy a template
Template
Loading templates…
Loading engines and profiles…
Loading…
Cancel
Create team
2 · A new team loads while you type
Team name and Start from work at once, and focus is in Team name as usual. The template select is off and says
"Loading templates…" until they arrive; the agents list waits for engines and profiles. Create team is off with
"Loading…" beside it: the one time it is off, because there is nothing to check yet. Blank waits only for those.
C · THE LOAD FAILED
Edit the Docs team
Couldn't load the team
Couldn't reach Agentry. Check it's running, then try again.
Try again
Cancel
3 · A failed load says why and tries again
Today's "Couldn't load the {thing}" banner, in danger-ink, with the server's words or the network line; focus
on Try again, which shows A again. The footer has only Cancel: there is nothing to save. On a new team the
title is "Couldn't load what a new team needs" and Team name keeps what was typed.
D · NO TEAM BY THAT NAME (?team=Docs, RENAMED OR REMOVED)
Couldn't find the Docs team
It may have been renamed or removed since this link was made. Its agents, if any
are left, are on the Agents page.
Back to the Agents page
4 · Never an empty Edit panel
An old link, another tab, or a reload after the team was renamed or removed. The title says so and takes focus,
as Edit's title does; no fields and no footer. Back to the Agents page and Close (×) close the panel and leave
/agents. A reload in E that finds no team by that name lands here too.
E · SAVE REFUSED: THE TEAM CHANGED SOMEWHERE ELSE
Edit the Docs team
Couldn't save the team: it changed since you opened it
The Docs team was changed somewhere else after you opened it. Copy anything
you want to keep, then reload to see the team as it is now.
Reload the team
Keep my changes here
After Reload the team, with changes, the box asks in place:
Reload and lose your changes?
Keep editing
Reload
5 · Changed somewhere else: refuse the save, keep the work
The save carries the version of the team the panel loaded. If an agent was edited on its own page, added with
+ Add agent on /agents/new or changed in another tab, the server refuses with 409 and nothing typed changes.
Focus moves to the box. Reload the team asks first (focus on Keep editing), then loads the team as it is now. Keep
my changes here closes the box and leaves Save on; the next save is refused again until you reload.
F · BROWSER BACK (OR THE PHONE'S BACK GESTURE), WITH CHANGES
/agents?team=Docs
Back pressed
Edit the Docs team
… the body as you left it: drafter "edited", researcher to be removed, critic "new" …
Discard your changes to Docs?
The team renamed, 1 agent changed, 1 added
and 1 removed. They aren't saved.
Keep editing
Discard
6 · Back is Close, and asks the same question
Opening the panel pushes one history entry (?team=…). Back with no changes closes the panel and lands on
/agents. Back with changes puts the entry back at once and asks Close's question in the footer, focus on
Keep editing; Discard then closes. Closing any other way (Close, Cancel, Discard, a save) goes back over our
entry, so Back never reopens a closed panel. Opened from a link or a reload there is no entry of ours to go
back over: closing replaces ?team=… with /agents. Reload and closing the tab get the browser's own prompt.
